title: How to buy
response: Ready when you are! Click the buy button on this page (or use this link: {{CHECKOUT_LINK}}) to open the secure checkout. Right after the payment is confirmed you get an e-mail with your download links.
followup: Anything you want to confirm before you check out?

title: Error at checkout
response: That is usually a browser or connection hiccup. Try: refresh the checkout page, switch to another browser or an incognito window, and disable any content blockers for the page. If it still fails, email {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} and we will send you a direct link.
followup: Want me to note your e-mail for follow-up?

title: Payment declined
response: Declines are usually a bank-side protection on international or online charges. Call your bank and authorize the transaction, or try another card. Some buyers also find a wallet option (like PayPal) at checkout, which can bypass the card issuer's block.
followup: Would you like to try the checkout link again?

title: Payment approved
response: As soon as the payment is approved, the access e-mail is sent automatically to the address you used at checkout. Check your inbox, then the spam and promotions folders. If it has not arrived within about 15 minutes, email {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} with your order details and we will resend it.
followup: Do you want help preparing the USB drive once the download arrives?

title: Charged twice
response: Sorry about that — it occasionally happens when a payment is retried. Send the transaction details to {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} and we will have the extra charge refunded through the processor. Nothing is kept that you did not intend to pay.
followup: Would you like to send us the details now?

title: Buying from another country
patterns: can i buy from another country
can i use an international card
response: Yes. The toolkit is a digital product, so you can buy and download it from anywhere. Checkout is in USD at {{PRICE}}, and an international card or a PayPal-style wallet both work.
followup: Would you like the checkout link?
